## A Callout Overlay

- The slide's own content
- Washes back when the overlay lands

. . .

::: {.overlay only="2"}
**The point to remember**

An `.overlay` boxes its content over the slide; `only="2"` limits it to that step in the PDF.
:::

## A Figure With Buttons {#tight-figure}

::: {.tight}
```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-width: 8
#| out-width: "70%"
par(mar = c(4, 4, 0.5, 0.5))
plot(pressure, pch = 19, col = "#750014")
```
:::

`.tight` keeps text next to the figure; button rows always sit at the bottom.
